description:
Get a list of articleIndicator objects that represent indicators of threat or compromise related to the contents of an article.

TIP: Lists indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with a threat intelligence article. Each indicator has artifact (hostname, IP, URL, file hash), source, and pattern details.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-threat-intel-article-indicators
